So far, this is like the game against Miami.  Atlanta pressed everything hard.  Were the better team through 35 min.  And yet haven't been able to score.  They need to put one away this half before NYCFC are able to escape to the half and regroup.

stop

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - made one important save 🧤 🧤 .  
Jacob - very active tonight.  A much better performance tonight.  Domininant defensively, and gets the ball up the pitch
Díaz - hasn't had much of a performance so far
Alonso - several good long balls are finding targets.  staying deeper this week.  More in control
Edwards - Is pushing higher than Báez does.  His crosses are not finding targets so doesn't present much of a threat
Amaro - quietly putting in a good performance.  Keeps putting himself into open pockets.  Very few missed plays going forward.
Galoppo - Not doing anything outstanding on either end.  Has had moments to connect with the front line.
Muyumba - Getting the ball up the pitch well, but distribution is lacking.  He nearly put in a goal off a free kick, and another that Freese was just able to tap away.
Miranchuk - decent as a playmaker, but not enough to stand out
Almirón - he's once again all over the place.  Once he passes the 18, he can't find a target.  Up until then, he's doing really well.  If he stays deper, he could be real dangerous.
Embolo - Some good hold-up play.  He did put one away, which was unfortunately chalked off.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - came up big again.  His quick reaction saves are top notch.  
Edwards - needed a better game in his start.  couldn't produce much going forward
Alonso - really good performance.  most long-balls found targets, prevented NYCFC from doing much
Díaz - under performed
Jacob - broke up a lot of plays.  his crosses, just do not find targets.  Hits them wildly
Galoppo - made some good runs and occasional plays.  But not enough
Muyumba - could have had 2 goals. But his distribution and decisions while running are lacking
Amaro - broke up several key place.  helped Atlanta retain possession
Miranchuk - I cannot see what he's providing going forward.  Good coming back for recoveries
Almirón - worked very hard off the ball.  ran himself into the ground.  BUt he's got to stay out of the final third where he cannot seem to put it away or pass
Embolo - worked very hard tonight. Never gave up when he could have.  Got his reward and nearly others

subs:
Picault - didn't provide a spark
Báez - his influence was only that he nearly got into a spat with Jones
